question: Should ClickClack adopt per-user, per-channel all/mentions/muted preferences and expose mentioned_user_ids as a supported HTTP/OpenAPI/SDK event contract?
rationale: The patch is broader than a local alert fix: it persists user settings, changes event storage, and publishes API surface external clients can rely on, so maintainers must choose the long-term product contract.

options.title: Adopt the notification contract
options.body: Approve the persisted preference, default-all upgrade behavior, and public endpoints/event field, then merge after required checks pass.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep the alert behavior private or defer the SDK/API exposure if the product should not yet guarantee this contract.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause the PR until a maintainer has selected the intended notification-settings model and compatibility policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt the notification contract
recommendation.body: Approve the persisted preference, default-all upgrade behavior, and public endpoints/event field, then merge after required checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: A repository-level product-contract decision is needed rather than a mechanical repair.
